title: ChipBlocks parameters manifest (default Active Variables)
description: Per ADR-007. Active Variables are typed, scoped, project-level named values that any block parameter can reference instead of carrying a literal. This file ships the default set (~28 builtin variables) that every new project starts with: physical constants, common electrical defaults, PCB defaults, solder/assembly defaults, feature flags. Each entry extends the provenance fragment with variable-specific fields (type, domain, scope, active, used_by). Users can override defaults (preserving previous_source / previous_value as audit trail) and add their own variables (which use the same shape with most provenance fields optional).

variables.description: Map of variable name -> variable entry. Variable names match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$ (lowercase snake_case).

type.description: Variable type. quantity = number with units; string = freeform text; enum = constrained string from `allowed` list; bool = boolean.

domain.description: Engineering domain. Used by the validator + UI to group variables and apply domain-specific checks.

value.description: The variable's current value. Number for quantity, string for string/enum, boolean for bool.

units.description: SI unit string (V, A, ohm, degC, etc.). Required for type=quantity.

allowed.description: Allowed values for type=enum. Required for enum; ignored otherwise.

scope.description: Resolution scope per ADR-007. project = applies everywhere; block = scoped to a composite block; release = active when a specific release profile is selected; simulation = active when a specific verification scenario runs.

active.description: Whether this variable participates in the resolution chain. false = defined but inert (useful for A/B testing or documenting alternatives).

description.description: User-facing description of what this variable represents and when to use it.

previous_source.description: Preserved when the user overrides a shipped default (audit trail). Original source.type + label + citation.

previous_value.description: Preserved when the user overrides a shipped default (audit trail).

used_by.description: Populated by the validator on each run. Dotted paths into the block graph (block_id.parameter_id). Not user-editable; regenerated automatically.
